Autofluorescence images werecollected with a Carl Zeiss microscopy AxioScan.Z1 using 3 channels/filters --DAPI (excitation: 335-383 nm/emission: 420-470 nm), eGFP (excitation: 450-490 nm/emission: 500-550 nm),and dsRed (excitation: 538-562 nm/emission: 570-640 nm). Support was provided by the NIH Common Fundand National Institute of Diabetes and Digestive and Kidney Diseases (U54 DK120058).
